newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia 1996 GDP rises 3.0 percent -- official.
newsitem.headline: Colombia 1996 GDP rises 3.0 percent -- official.

text.p: Colombia's gross domestic product (GDP) grew 3.0 percent in 1996, a spokesman of the National Planning Department said Wednesday.

The figure was less than the original target rate of between 4.5 percent and 5.0 percent set in January. That figure was later scaled down to less than 3.0 percent as economic slowdown began to sink in.

The figure for 1996 GDP growth was ratified by the National Council for Economic and Political Planing, a joint body made up of all government ministers with an economic portfolio and the National Planning Department.
The Planning Department spokesman said the agricultural sector, industry and business had been the hardest hit by the economic slump.
He said the government had approved a GDP growth rate forecast of between 4.0 percent and 4.5 percent for 1997.
